tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Summary of HeroX AirDomes: applications, typical project budgets, sizes, lead times, options, warranty and financing. Use before answering any pricing or capability question.

tools.name: list_planning_packages
tools.description: List the fixed-price planning packages a customer can buy online (concept sketch, renders, custom virtual tour, technician site visit) with IDs and USD prices.

tools.name: start_planning_package_purchase
tools.description: Get the checkout link for a planning package so the user can pay securely on heroxairdomes.com. Does not charge anything; the user completes payment themselves.

tools.name: book_consultation
tools.description: Get the booking link for a free 1:1 product overview and ROI estimate call with the HeroX team. Use when the user wants a quote, a site-specific price, or to talk to sales.

tools.name: list_site_pages
tools.description: List the main pages of heroxairdomes.com with absolute URLs and what each page is for.

tools.name: calculate_dome_roi
tools.description: Run the HeroX ROI calculator (https://www.heroxairdomes.com/resources/roi): payback period, 5- and 10-year ROI, net annual income and a 10-year cumulative cash flow. All money in USD. This is an estimate for planning purposes only, not a quote.

tools.name: estimate_dome_opex
tools.description: Run the HeroX OPEX calculator (https://www.heroxairdomes.com/resources/opex): annual and monthly costs for fan/inflation, heating, cooling and lighting. Length, width and target temperature are always given in ft and °F (the page's slider values); unit_system only switches the page to metric display

tools.name: estimate_additional_costs
tools.description: Run the HeroX Additional Costs Estimator (https://www.heroxairdomes.com/resources/additional-costs): foundation, permitting, site prep, utilities, cranes, workforce, HVAC and (US) general contracting costs beyond the dome itself. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_company_overview" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Summary of HeroX AirDomes: applications, typical project budgets, sizes, lead times, options, warranty and financing. Use before answering any pricing or capabi…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
